title: What the Fire Keeps

arc.title: The Cold Stone
arc.subtitle: a warm stone, already going cold

epigraph.text: The fire keeps its own count and tells nobody; the hand that feeds it keeps another and has no one to tell it to.
epigraph.attribution: A proverb of the Low Kiln kiln-houses, told at the coming of Ash

pov: Daniel Marchetti (Corin), close third-person past tense inside a body of three hundred and thirty to three hundred and thirty-two days, six months and one hundred and fifty to one hundred and fifty-two days, carried everywhere in a basket and told by nobody. No present-tense break and no tagged memory; the old life is carried by the surgeon's register alone. Each morning that register takes the body in its old order — the stiff leathery brown-edged barley crust two inches from the ear with its corner standing a hair off the wool, its empty place unnamed and no third; the thread of drool frozen in the dry kiln heat and unwiped, because nobody under any roof has ever been given an instruction about the thread; cold stopped at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint where the wool rides back, as at the end of a line written out for it; the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody in this house will perform — and reads the world as a trauma bay is read, by the small sounds first because the small sounds do not lie. He knows a cold patient cannot clot and will seem better before he is worse, and must be warmed from outside and slowly, never rubbed, never set too near the fire; he knows the composed face is not composure. He knows the infant's want of the crust lifted, the thread wiped and a hand on the pot handle is louder than the surgeon's knowing, and neither wins, and the argument is the work. Three counts in three places that do not become one, since agreeing any two would want a payer put under both and none stands: the carried fire's four low pulls with its fifth unpaid through three hundred and thirty, thirty-one and thirty-two days and its payer unnamed; the boards' four nails, four and a thumb-width knot; the river's water over water, a low thing over a lower thing, nearer at the going of the water than at its coming, not numbered among the hearings. Six hearings of the full note stand beside and never among with the seventh place empty, the sixth the small flat knock out of a woman as the men lifted her, filed where a thing out of a person must go and never among the sources; the heard bell stays in its square beside the told bell of the Long Night; the told figure beside the paid with no signature between. Ash comes on without a boundary drawn and neither of the district's two habits of naming its months is corrected; the dark month is named and not explained, and the thinning Warm is weather, entered nowhere.
places: the flat stone by the well

scenes.title: The First Morning of Ash
scenes.synopsis: First of six entries, the chapter's only \dropcap and its first \daymark{330}{Ash 1, Firstday, Y.H. 813}: the small hours under the Vail kiln-house roof into the first light of an ordinary Firstday with no market, Cross or bell. Open on the hand laid down against the fold on answer 234 as a tool put away where the next hand will find it without looking; the hand outside the wool comes up for the two hundred and thirty-fifth. Do not recap Chapter 92. Carry 329 to 330 exact, six months and one hundred and fifty days told by nobody (T071/T072); the carried fire's fifth unpaid 330 days with its payer unnamed (T088); Garl's name unspoken the same number (T009/T013/T092). Ash comes on without a boundary drawn and neither of the district's two habits of naming its months is corrected; the dark month is named and not explained, and the thinning Warm is called weather. Nothing from Bone 30 crosses as sign, lesson, mending, cause or payment; six arithmetics of the year in Berr's locked box are six and not one account, one in twelve printed and unchallenged, figure read not figure paid, no signature on the space, and the finding kept on a place of its own with no payer. Body inventory in the surgeon's old order: crust two inches from the ear, stiff and leathery in the dry kiln heat, corner standing a hair off the wool, empty place unnamed and no third; thread frozen and unwiped; cold at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint as at the end of a line written out for it; the afterdrop beyond a warming nobody here will perform. The surgeon knows the composed face is not composure, knows a cold patient cannot clot and must be warmed from outside and slowly, never rubbed, never set too near the fire; the infant wants the crust lifted two inches, the thread wiped and a hand on the pot handle. Both true, the second louder, the argument the work (T060/T086). Sella goes to the fire before the basket, tells the coals it is the thaw, turns them with the back of a broken pot, says The house will keep it where another woman would say I, counts a small intake, a hold and a letting-go toward no opening with neither gap figured, keeps her finger on top of the loaf shelf so the charcoal tally stays unread, moves her lips along a two-gapped row unfigured, glances once at the clay jar cold under lead glaze with the hand half over nothing and the little-door burn closing on air (T058/T079/T100). The twice-mended pot is lifted thumb-first where the wire crosses the crack, both proverbs to pot and fire, the crack left showing; the dressed grain is turned under wool with the lighter touch and no figure and no handful; the pot rim is set two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed (T009/T013/T092, T077). The widow's mark is untouched — a morning and a hearth are not openings; five openings in five months are five and not a rule, with the sixth standing at Ash 2 one morning ahead and not brought in. Three counts in three places that do not become one; six hearings beside and never among with the seventh place empty; heard bell beside told; told figure beside paid; file open on the towel with every gap left gap; the staying, the early letting-go, the handful and Tarn's thumb's resting four objects on four places and none made again; four held changes on four places and not a rule. Answer 235: the hand goes up an inch toward the river's note, takes a small intake from the room whose floor does not touch his, holds the interval whole, lets it go on the same low note and comes straight down as a tool put away; the note had done before the hand came down, so neither early again nor stayed, borrowing no house count and supplying no payer (T061/T082). Exact last image: the hand laid back against the fold as a man puts away a tool where the next hand will find it without looking, the file open on the towel with every gap left gap, the river's note coming low under the finger's-width door, Ash 1 one morning short of the sixth opening.

scenes.title: The Dark Month Goes Around
scenes.synopsis: Second entry of Day 330, no new dated heading: afternoon through the going of the light and into the small hours at the Clay Yard, the rack end, the yard well and flat stone, the worked strips, the kindling, the flagstones, the wheel-shed edge and damper, the back room from outside, and the bed, boards and towel. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella, Tarn, Jorra; walk-ons (Cold Acre hare-carrier, man with cracked jar in rope sling); Garl in objects. No Ilva, no market, no Cross, no bell. Sella carries him down at the half-pace from every open slate, gives the instruction to the wool and the river wind and never to the basket, and goes wide around the seven walked-around places with a look and a wide step and no number: the clean dark line at the Vail corner and the finer grey hairline beside it called the thaw, unswept both; the space beneath the lowest rack where the broken birth-slates lie; the round ring where the shallow clay pan once stood with no scrape, crumb, print, chip or word; the trough's skin of ice; the field's empty place out on the worked strips; the returning-line place where a hand went in on Seed 15 and did not come out — no eighth likeness, no cause across two, no payer (T009/T013/T092, T098 carried). Three coverings stay weather entered nowhere with a finger between every pair: the frost gone off the well's north lip on Bone 3 while the yard looked elsewhere, which is not a sign; the skin on the trough breaking and closing under a pail's knock; the silt-clouded plate of ice on the flat stone out of the path of feet. In the first Ash cold the rope stiffens, the trough's skin lies longer and the coals are banked earlier, and the yard calls all of it weather and gives nobody a figure (T083/T085 held). Hunts and repairs stay directions judged by the carrying arm and the weather, never figures: the Cold Acre hare answered with the weather and gone toward the clay road with nobody weighing it or opening a slate; the cracked jar in a rope sling answered with the pot, and the pot says nothing. The boy reads both as a chart left blank where the number should stand and enters neither (T077). At the rack end the dressed grain lies turned under wool with a lighter touch and no figure; her fingers go in and come out and do not close, and no handful is lifted — the empty fingers are a keeping beside the one object, not a second (T077 held). Tarn at the kindling: six where the house can check and the seventh at the lip beside Garl's unforged collector sentence, the knife at the very edge of its sill where it can be checked and where a hand could slip it; Six counted. The next I don't count; the ear-sentence brought to the word that would call the loan and stopped as a remembered ninth stopping, no tenth before the seventh year at its very end; the Seed 16 breath unspent, his chest tight since the dark, Ash in the knuckle creases in the colour of the clean dark line, the pale clip-ring holding what little light there is, his stroke over the shallow bright patch without the half-check, and the warm loft stone cold in its unmarked pot and unreconciled by not trying, which is not forgiveness. The thumb's resting on the uncut seventh on Bone 26 is checked as one object on its own place and is not made again on Ash 1: not a tenth stopping, not the seventh year given, not a payment, not a fifth held change, not a hearing, not a mending, not a rule, with no payer standing (T036/T076/T006 held). Jorra at the shed's edge: dusty forearms parted from clean as clot from vessel, meal-fine grey slate dust past the bent finger and white in a fist-crease, not the bone-coloured slip of the wheel; men unnamed going low into the back room before first grey and the room not said cold; the wheel first — It doesn't care whose hands. It cares if they're steady — then You'll do to a pot; the full note known three turns ahead with air under it and a want in it and withheld from a High Kiln master who would call it early and make a song of it; the bent finger into the cold damper ahead of Sella's unfinished sentence so the end of it arrives at the pot; one iron with two bites and no Grathic word for both mercies; he's not Vail sealed and the promise of the boy's name neither given nor withdrawn; the burned slate at five with a finger between the fifth and the four (T035/T031/T062/T065/T095). Garl in objects: the salt-stiff coat with the left-shoulder crease, the hollow wheel-seat, the clean dark line and finer grey unswept, the twice-mended pot with both proverbs gone to pot and fire and never to a person, the tile debt uncalled, his name unspoken 330 days, no lesson made. Sella carries him up at the going of the light, half-pace, fold righted without a look at his face, thread left, never into the Debt Loft, a sound from above and behind only and no interior entered. Fire four and a gap; boards four, four and a knot; river water over water — three counts that do not become one. Answer 236 at the very end: a small intake let go whole on the river's note; the note had done before the hand came down, so neither early again nor stayed. Exact last image: the hand back against the fold on the two hundred and thirty-sixth answer, the file still open on the towel with every gap gap, Ash 2 one morning ahead and not brought in.

scenes.title: The Sixth Opening
scenes.synopsis: Third entry and second dated \daymark{331}{Ash 2, Secondday, Y.H. 813}: the small hours under the Vail roof into the dark month's first firing at the kiln mouth, then back to the bed, boards and towel. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella; yard walk-ons at the first firing (women putting pots down, a man with a wet pot stopped out of the draught); Garl in objects. No Ilva, no market, no Cross, no bell, no collector. New day, new date, no recap; nothing from Ash 1 crosses as sign, lesson, mending, cause or payment. Carry 330 to 331 exact, six months and one hundred and fifty-one days told by nobody (T071/T072); the carried fire's fifth unpaid 331 days, payer unnamed (T088); Garl's name unspoken the same number (T009/T013/T092). The kilns have been brought up for the dark month's first firing; the yard stands in the hot dry smell of clay giving up its water, with tallow from the wheel-shed under it and the sweetish edge of lead glaze on a wrong wind off High Kiln, a direction arrived nowhere and not a second edge paid. Body inventory renewed in the surgeon's old order; surgeon versus infant quarrel, both true, the second louder, the argument the work (T060/T086). THE CHAPTER'S ONE MEANINGFUL CHANGE, ADVANCED AND NOT PAID (T058/T079, T088): Sella carries the basket to the kiln mouth and sets it down level where no slate lay, out of the draught, where the heat comes to him sideways and not full; before she gives any instruction to the basket and before any word is spoken, she puts her hand to the widow's mark at her throat — a thumb-length of lead-glazed clay with the Vail kiln scratched into it, the cord oiled where a working thumb has touched it ten thousand times, the little-door burn on the back of her left hand half-closing on the cord. She holds the mark one breath and lets go. She lifts the clay lid with the back of a hand and tips the carried coal under the back of a broken pot; the fire takes, still answering four low pulls with the silence where the fifth should have stood and its payer unnamed 331 days. Six openings in six months — Tallow 1, Ember 1, Smoke 1, Frost 2, Bone 2 and Ash 2 — are six and not a rule; no seventh is made due, nobody praises the opening, names what it mended, enters a slate or makes a lesson, sign, mending or payer of it, and the five behind are not looked at again as signs or payments. She does not touch the mark again at shelf, well, rack, road, basket, yard, morning, afternoon, dusk or going of the light on Ash 2, because the hand goes to the mark before the kiln and at no other hour. The boy takes the opening as a field is taken before the light, by the small sounds: the little scrape of the clay lid lifted with the back of a hand, the coal going under the back of a broken pot, the fire taking in fours with the gap. He does not make it a sign, lesson, mending, cause or payment, does not join it to the five openings, to the six arithmetics, to the bell's gap, to the covered grain or to the carried fire's missing fifth except to note that the fifth is still missing; no collector comes up or goes down the clay road (T009/T013/T092). After the taking the hearth grammar resumes: The house will keep it; coals told the thaw and turned with the back of a broken pot; intake, hold and letting-go toward no opening with neither gap figured; the twice-mended pot thumb-first at the wire with both proverbs and the crack showing; the pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed; the dressed grain turned under wool with a lighter touch and no figure and no handful (T058/T079/T100, T077). Six hearings beside and never among with the seventh place empty; three counts in three places that do not become one; told figure beside paid; finding on a place of its own. Answer 237: hand up an inch toward the river's note, small intake, interval held whole, let go on the same low note, straight down as a tool put away; the note had done before the hand came down, so neither early again nor stayed (T061/T082). Exact last image: the hand laid back against the fold on the two hundred and thirty-seventh answer, the fire behind the wall still answering four pulls and a silence, the widow's mark back under the working thumb and not touched again.

scenes.title: An Ordinary Day After
scenes.synopsis: Fourth entry, no new dated heading: the afternoon of Ash 2 through the going of the light and the small hours at the Clay Yard, the seven walked-around places, the rack end, the yard well and flat stone, the kindling, the flagstones, the wheel-shed edge and damper, and the bed, boards and towel. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella, Tarn, Jorra, Ilva (seen once at the well with her strip unread); a woman asking at the well; walk-ons (Cold Acre hare-carrier, cracked-jar man); Garl in objects. No market, Cross or bell; no collector. The day after the opening is an ordinary tending day, and that ordinariness is the point. Sella carries him at the half-pace and goes wide around the seven walked-around places with a look and a wide step and no number; the three coverings stay weather entered nowhere with a finger between every pair; the day's first firing stands in the yard with nobody making a feast of it and nobody crossing himself (T009/T013/T092, T083/T085 held, T098 carried). At the yard well Ilva draws with the pail against her knee, the rope stiff in the Ash cold giving its small dry rasp as the bucket comes up, clay dried pale in the crescents of her nails and the finer grey rack dust worked into the seam of one thumb she does not scrub out; her hands know the weight of a pail and the edge of a wet board and have never been soft, and people notice the pail first and the sleeve not at all. A woman asks what the firings of Ash have taken. Ilva's hand goes toward her sleeve and stays; the short strip of notched birch bark, pale where a thumb has rubbed the notches and dark in the uncut grain between, is not taken out, read, copied, counted or joined to the open slate a pace away, the charcoal under the loaf shelf, the cord, the knot-string or the ownerless saying, and no figure comes off the wood. Her eyes go to the asker and her mouth opens after both with a half-beat between, and she answers the question put and not the one behind it: Ask the pot what it cost. I keep the count, not the account. She puts the flat of her hand once more on the sleeve and goes back to the pail, and nobody turns twice. The boy takes the order of reaching apart as a chart is taken apart and files it as the ninth record-first hand on a place of its own with a finger between it and Hessa Rale's eighth, files no tenth, makes no figure of the slate's nearness, makes her no reader of her own keeping and joins her to none (T080 advanced, not paid). Hunts and repairs stay directions answered with the weather, the river and the pot, leaving no entry (T077). At the rack end the dressed grain lies covered under wool, turned with a lighter touch and given no figure and no handful; her fingers go in and come out without closing (T077 held). Tarn at the kindling keeps six where the house can check and the seventh at the lip beside Garl's unforged collector sentence, the ear-sentence brought to the calling word and stopped as a ninth stopping with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end, the Seed 16 breath unspent, his chest tight, Ash in the knuckle creases, the pale clip-ring holding light, his stroke over the bright patch without the half-check, and the warm loft stone cold in its unmarked pot and unreconciled by not trying. The thumb's resting on the uncut seventh on Bone 26 is checked as one object and is not made again on Ash 2: not a tenth stopping, not the seventh year given, not a payment, not a fifth held change, not a hearing, not a mending, not a rule (T036/T076/T006 held). Jorra at the shed's edge and damper: grey dust past the bent finger and white in a fist-crease, not slip; men unnamed before first grey; the wheel first and a pot after; the full note known three turns ahead and withheld from a High Kiln master who would make a song of it; the bent finger into the cold damper ahead of Sella's unfinished sentence; one iron with two bites and no Grathic word for both mercies; he's not Vail sealed and the promise neither given nor withdrawn; the burned slate at five (T035/T031/T062/T065/T095). Garl stays in objects with his name unspoken 331 days, his tile debt uncalled, the twice-mended pot's crack showing and both proverbs gone to pot and fire. Sella carries him up at the going of the light at the half-pace, fold righted without a look, thread left, never into the Debt Loft, a sound from above and behind only; the opened kiln behind them and the carried fire under their floor both breathe four and a gap, three counts in three places that do not become one. Answer 238 at the very end: a small intake let go whole on the river's note; neither early again nor stayed. Exact last image: the hand back against the fold on the two hundred and thirty-eighth answer, Ilva's strip still in her sleeve and no figure off the wood, the opened kiln missed its fifth behind the wall for the three hundred and thirty-first day.

scenes.title: The Third Morning
scenes.synopsis: Fifth entry and third dated \daymark{332}{Ash 3, Thirdday, Y.H. 813}: the small hours under the Vail kiln-house roof into the first light of an ordinary Thirdday with no market, Cross or bell. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella; Garl in objects. No Ilva, no Tarn, no Jorra on stage this morning, no collector. New day, new date, no recap; nothing from Ash 2 crosses as sign, lesson, mending, cause or payment, and the sixth opening is not looked at again as a sign and no seventh is made due. Carry 331 to 332 exact, six months and one hundred and fifty-two days told by nobody (T071/T072); the carried fire's fifth unpaid 332 days with its payer unnamed (T088); Garl's name unspoken the same number (T009/T013/T092). Body inventory renewed in the surgeon's old order: the stiff brown-edged crust two inches from the ear with its empty place unnamed and no third; the thread frozen and unwiped; cold at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint as at the end of a line written out for it; the afterdrop beyond a warming nobody here will perform. The composed face is not composure; a cold patient cannot clot and must be warmed from outside and slowly, never rubbed, never set too near the fire; the infant wants the crust lifted, the thread wiped and a hand on the pot handle, both true, the second louder, neither winning, the argument the work (T060/T086). The hearth grammar holds the morning after the opening: fire before basket, coals told the thaw and turned with the back of a broken pot, The house will keep it where another woman would say I, a small intake, a hold and a letting-go toward no opening with neither gap figured, her finger on top of the loaf shelf so the charcoal stays unread, her lips along a two-gapped row unfigured, one glance at the clay jar cold under lead glaze with the hand half over nothing and the little-door burn closing on air, the twice-mended pot lifted thumb-first at the wire with both proverbs to pot and fire and the crack showing, the dressed grain turned under wool with a lighter touch and no figure and no handful, the pot rim set two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed (T058/T079/T100, T077). The widow's mark is untouched this morning — a morning and a hearth are not openings; six openings in six months are six and not a rule; the hand went to the mark before the kiln yesterday and not again today (T058/T079). Her little-door burn closes on nothing when she carries a cup; the grey streak at her temple shows pale; she pushes coal-black hair back with the burn-wrist and does not look toward the bed. Three counts in three places that do not become one; six hearings beside and never among with the seventh place empty; heard bell beside told; told figure beside paid; file open on the towel with every gap left gap; the staying, the early letting-go, the handful and the thumb's resting four objects on four places and none made again; four held changes on four places and not a rule. Six arithmetics ride locked in Berr's box, one in twelve unchallenged, figure read not figure paid, no signature on the space, six readings six and not one account, the finding kept on a place of its own with no payer and not laid across the house's not-doings, the covered grain, the four held changes, the handful, the thumb's resting, the two small objects of the hand or his own gaps — the finger goes between (T015/T041/T047). Ash 10 (Day 339), the dark month's first Account-day and market, stands seven mornings ahead and is not brought in; Ash's first arithmetic belongs to a later chapter. Answer 239: hand up an inch toward the river's note, small intake, interval held whole, let go on the same low note, straight down as a tool put away; the note had done before the hand came down, so neither early again nor stayed (T061/T082). Exact last image: the hand laid back against the fold on the two hundred and thirty-ninth answer, the file open on the towel with every gap left gap, the river's low note under the finger's-width door, Ash 3 two days short of its first reading.

scenes.title: The First Days Go Out
scenes.synopsis: Sixth and final entry, chapter close, no new dated heading: Day 332, Ash 3, the going of the light and the small hours at the Clay Yard, the yard well and flat stone, the rack end, the kindling, the flagstones, the wheel-shed edge and damper, the bed, boards and towel. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella, Tarn, Jorra; walk-ons (Cold Acre hare-carrier, cracked-jar man, woman with a basket of kindling, two men mending a strip of fence); Garl in objects. No Ilva, no Berr, no Hessa, no clerk, no green or shape at the close, no collector, no market, Cross or bell. Ash goes out as it came on, without a boundary drawn, and neither of the district's two habits of naming its months is corrected; the yard goes around its seven walked-around places with a look and a wide step and no number; the three coverings stay weather entered nowhere with a finger between every pair and no fourth likeness made a cause; the month's hunts and repairs stay directions judged by the carrying arm and the weather, never figures (T009/T013/T092, T083/T085 held, T098 carried, T077). Hunts and repairs: a man down from Cold Acre answers the price of his hare with the weather and goes toward the clay road with nobody weighing it or opening a slate; a man with a cracked jar in a rope sling is told to ask the pot, and the pot says nothing; a woman with a basket of kindling asks what the seventh year will want when it comes and two fence-menders say the thaw will be early and late; Tarn says Yes, house to each and keeps the late because a late thaw puts off the paying, agreeing so thoroughly that no argument can find a foot; no collector comes up or down the clay road (T036/T076, T077). Tarn's knife lies at the very edge of its sill, six where the house can check and the seventh at the lip beside Garl's unforged collector sentence; the ear-sentence comes to the word that would call the loan and stops as a ninth stopping with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end, the Seed 16 breath unspent, his chest tight, Ash in the knuckle creases, the clip-ring holding light; the thumb's resting on the uncut seventh of Bone 26 is checked and not made again on Ash 1, 2 or 3 (T036/T076/T006 held). Jorra at the shed's edge and damper: grey dust past the bent finger and white in a fist-crease, not slip; men unnamed before first grey; the wheel first and a pot after; the full note known three turns ahead and withheld from a High Kiln master who would call it early and make a song of it; the bent finger into the cold damper ahead of Sella's unfinished sentence; one iron with two bites and no Grathic word for both mercies; he's not Vail sealed and the promise neither given nor withdrawn (T035/T031/T062/T065/T095). The whole tray is checked and left as it lay: the burned slate at five with no sixth, no witness and no hand at the flame; the ownerless row at five askings with one shaping and expressly no sixth; the well-saying at three shapings with Hessa Rale's eighth on its own place and no fourth made a cause; the shut-room tellings at two; three pot sayings with the Smoke 14 note apart; nine record-first hands with Ilva's ninth in a sleeve and no tenth; nine stoppings with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end, the loan uncalled; six hearings beside and never among, the seventh place empty, the sixth the small flat knock out of a woman as the men lifted her, filed where a thing out of a person must go; five openings in five months with the sixth now behind at Ash 2 — six openings in six months are six and not a rule and no seventh is made due; seven green a colour and seven shape a shape with no eighth; the heard bell in its square beside the told bell of the Long Night. Every object stays on its own place with a finger between; no joining, no cause, no payer. The finding that six are six and not one account is kept on a place of its own with no payer and is not laid across the house's not-doings, the dressed grain covered under wool and read over by a number that did not know its cost, the four held changes, the handful, the thumb's resting, the two small objects of the hand or his own gaps; the edges come near to touching and the finger goes between; no doctrine stands up out of any of it, for a doctrine is an account that has found a payer and none stood (T015/T041/T047). Garl stays in objects: the salt-stiff coat with the left-shoulder crease, the hollow wheel-seat nobody fills, the clean dark line and the finer grey unswept, the twice-mended pot on the pot board with the hairline of the original break showing between the old-brass staple and the tighter wire and both proverbs gone to pot and fire and never to a person, so repair stays apart from restoration; the debt against a firing of tiles is neither paid nor settled nor done with and is worse for being uncalled; his name unspoken 332 days, no lesson made (T009/T013/T092). Sella carries him up at the going of the light at the half-pace from every open slate, goes wide around the seven walked-around places, sets him on the bed under the roof and never in the Debt Loft, puts the fold right at his ear and under his chin without a look at his face, lets her hand rest the half-beat longer than the setting needed before it goes away, and leaves the thread where it lay; she says nothing of where they have been and gives the instruction to the fire, the wool and the pot and never to the basket, saying The house will keep it where another woman would say I. The widow's mark hangs where it hung and is not touched, because a going of the light and a bed are not openings and six openings in six months are six and not a rule. She goes to the hearth before the basket, tells the coals it is the thaw and turns them with the back of a broken pot, and the fire answers four low pulls with the silence where the fifth should have stood, its payer unnamed 332 days. Her finger lies on top of the loaf shelf's front edge so the charcoal tally stays unread; her lips move along a two-gapped row unfigured; she glances once at the clay jar cold under lead glaze and shuts her hand half over nothing, the little-door burn closing on air; the twice-mended pot comes up thumb-first at the wire with both proverbs to pot and fire and the crack showing; the dressed grain lies under wool with a lighter touch and no figure and no handful, her fingers going in and coming out without closing (T058/T079/T100, T077). Under the floor the carried fire gives four low pulls and the silence where the fifth should stand; overhead the boards keep four nails on the near board, four on the next and a thumb-width knot where a fifth might have been driven and was not; through the finger's-width door water over water goes low over lower, nearer at the going of the water than at its coming, not numbered among the hearings. Three counts in three places and none rises into another, because agreeing any two would want a payer put under both and none stands to any. The bell's gap left in the square is not fetched in to make a fourth; the heard bell stays beside the told and the told figure beside the paid with no signature between. Answer 240 at the very end: the hand goes up an inch toward the river's note, takes a small intake from the room whose floor does not touch his, holds the interval whole, lets the intake go on the same low note and comes straight down and lays itself back against the fold as a man puts away a tool where the next hand will find it without looking. The note had done before the hand came down, so the letting-go was neither early again nor stayed and the hand did not stay; the inch was not a reach, the intake not a breath kept for warmth, the interval not a stopping of the river and the note not his. He files it as answer 240: exact, complete, worth nothing at two inches of air, a restraint and not a payment, borrowing no house count and supplying no payer, laid across neither the six arithmetics, the bell's gap, the covered grain, the handful, the thumb's resting, the stayed object, the early letting-go, the sixth opening nor his own gaps. Two hundred and forty honest answers stand on the sixth place, each an object and not a power, and neither the number nor the small hand-movings that made it stood up and called themselves a doctrine, for a doctrine is an account that has found a payer and none stood. The surgeon takes his small clean satisfaction in a field left as found and an answer entered where nobody can see it; the infant underneath takes none, wants the crust lifted and the thread wiped and a hand on the pot handle, both true, the second louder, neither winning, the two registers quarrelling without verdict in the small hours. Three hundred and thirty-two stands exact, complete, unspent and spoken by nobody in Low Kiln, Sill and Grath; six months and one hundred and fifty-two days are told by nobody; the carried fire's fifth is unpaid the same number of days with its payer unnamed; and the name of the man the salt-stiff coat kept is unspoken the same number. Nothing on Ash 3 was opened, joined, named, called, paid or ended. Ash went out without a boundary drawn and neither of the district's two habits of naming its months was set right; the keeping of the number was the only honest work there had been to do, bought nothing at two inches of air and was not for sale, and went on because attention is the one thing no institution can tax. The silt-clouded plate of ice stands on its flat stone out of the path of feet; the file lies open on the towel with every gap left gap; the hand lies back against the fold on answer 240; and the river's low note goes quiet under the finger's-width door while Ash goes on without a boundary drawn. Ash 4 (Day 333) stands one morning ahead and is not brought into a day that has not earned it; Ash 10 (Day 339), the dark month's first Account-day and market, stands seven mornings ahead and is not brought early. Forward, not closed. Exact last image: the hand back against the fold on the two hundred and fortieth answer, the file open on the towel with every gap left gap, the silt-clouded plate of ice standing on its flat stone out of the path of feet, and the river's low note going quiet under the finger's-width door while Ash goes out without a boundary drawn.
